parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front lower part of the toaster, used to control settings such as cancel or reheat.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to stop or adjust the toasting process manually.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular plastic slider located on the side of the toaster, used to lower and raise the bread carriage.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal heating mechanism and timer when pushed down.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically along a slot, locking in place during operation and releasing when toasting is complete.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: An internal slider component that connects to the external lever, guiding the bread carriage mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It transmits the motion from the external lever to the internal carriage system.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically in coordination with the external slider, ensuring smooth mechanical operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster made of stainless steel, housing all internal components and providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the heating elements, wiring, and mechanical parts, ensuring safety and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable base for all other moving parts.
